lessons: The ticket can't pass as written: its Verification runs tests/unit/test_index_build.py, but line 283 of that file (test_default_creator) asserts [f"INSTALL {kind}", f"LOAD {kind}"] and the file is outside the scope fence. Add tests/unit/test_index_build.py to ## Scope fence.

Rewrite the ticket to require changing tests/unit/test_index_build.py:283 to assert conn.calls == [f"LOAD {kind}"]. Line 287 can stay: Recorder(True) fails every execute, so the fallback still returns [f"{kind} unavailable: offline"].

The failed branch d75465f57 already has the scoped loader change in clutch/index.py and both new tests. Per the run record, the reproducer printed defect on base and pass on the branch. After the fence fix, change only test_index_build.py:283 and rerun ./dev.py test

Class prevention for the ticket author: before filing a behavior change, search tests/ for assertions on the old behavior (here grep "INSTALL {kind}") and fence every test that pins it, as the project CLAUDE.md requires for tests pinning a changed value.
